task.title: Resolve Conflicts with AI
task.shortdesc: Let Positron analyze a conflict and propose a resolution you can review and apply.

step.cmd: Right-click the conflicting file and select .

stepresult.p:
Positron analyzes the conflicting file and its common ancestor, then opens the
window.

info.p:
The
pane explains the change, and the diff views let you compare the resolved file against your version, the incoming version, and the original conflict. Edit the result if you want, or restore the original AI suggestion.

result.p: The Git Client writes the resolution to your working copy and stages the file.
